items.speaker: marta
items.text: Let’s start with the budget, since that is the one decision we need today.

items.speaker: dario
items.text: I sent the numbers on Friday. Travel is the line that moved.

items.speaker: guest
items.text: Do we know why it moved? Was it the two client visits in September?

items.speaker: dario
items.text: So the client visits explain most of it. Two trips, both late in the quarter.

items.speaker: marta
items.text: Then we keep travel at twelve thousand in the budget and look again in January.

items.speaker: guest
items.text: Agreed. I will write that down as the decision.

items.speaker: marta
items.text: Thanks for making the time. We wanted to go through the delivery dates before the end of the month.

items.speaker: giulia
items.text: Of course. On our side the main worry is the second phase, the data migration. We need it done before the audit in December.

items.speaker: guest
items.text: And we have only two people who can sign off on it, so any slip there moves everything.

items.speaker: marta
items.text: Understood. Then let us fix the migration first and move the reporting work to January.

items.speaker: giulia
items.text: That works for us if we see a test run by the twentieth.
